newsitem.title: USA: NEBRASKA FED CATTLE TRADE QUIET, NO SALES - USDA.
newsitem.headline: NEBRASKA FED CATTLE TRADE QUIET, NO SALES - USDA.

text.p: Trading on slaughter steers and heifers was quiet, with no sales, USDA said.

Buyer inquiry good, and bids range from 104.00-105.00. Seller interest light, with many pricing cattle 105.00-106.00. Most recent volume price test Thursday at mostly 105.00. Weekly trade volume of 51,700 did not "clean up" showlists.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights)
Slaughter Heifers - No reported sales. Sales confirmed - None, For the week - None.
